paper_title: Kernelization of the Subset General Position Problem in Geometry
statement: of the convex hull conv(S) of S. Although the upper bounds for kernelization given in this paper hold for this problem, lower bound questions remain open for both primal and dual parameter.
context: General position with respect to spheres is also connected to Delaunay Subset Selection problem where we are given a point set P ⊂ Rd as input and the problem is to extract a maximum size subset S of P such that the Delaunay complex Del(S) is a triangulation of the convex hull conv(S) of S. Although the upper bounds for kernelization given in this paper hold for this problem, lower bound questions remain open for both primal and dual parameter.
